name: mechama
description: Plataforma digital que conecta clientes a prestadores de serviços

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend/gateway && npm install && cd ../services/auth && npm install && cd ../users && npm install && cd ../services && npm install && cd ../payments && npm install && cd ../notifications && npm install && cd ../scheduling && npm install && cd ../reviews && npm install
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:users" "npm run dev:services" "npm run dev:payments" "npm run dev:notifications" "npm run dev:scheduling" "npm run dev:reviews"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend/gateway && npm run build && cd ../services/auth && npm run build && cd ../users && npm run build && cd ../services && npm run build && cd ../payments && npm run build && cd ../notifications && npm run build && cd ../scheduling && npm run build && cd ../reviews && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend/gateway && npm run test && cd ../services/auth && npm run test && cd ../users && npm run test && cd ../services && npm run test && cd ../payments && npm run test && cd ../notifications && npm run test && cd ../scheduling && npm run test && cd ../reviews && npm run test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend/gateway && npm run lint && cd ../services/auth && npm run lint && cd ../users && npm run lint && cd ../services && npm run lint && cd ../payments && npm run lint && cd ../notifications && npm run lint && cd ../scheduling && npm run lint && cd ../reviews && npm run lint
